deployment_source.canonical_year_rule: parsed start_date.year is the sole canonical survey year
deployment_source.auxiliary_start_year_disposition: ignore completely for context definition and scientific features; do not drop or alter deployments because of its token
deployment_source.diagnostic_basis: all 820 start_date values are complete; auxiliary start_year is predominantly two-digit and has 13 token-0 rows whose canonical start_date year is 2019
deployment_source.active_interval_semantics: half-open [start_date, end_date); no response-derived effort repair

world_context.reason: deployment-relative repeated intervals are contemporaneous only within the same subproject survey year

time_bin_selection.selection_rule: choose the largest candidate width satisfying every frozen availability condition; if none satisfy, terminal STOP

structural_ladder.distance: Haversine great-circle km, earth radius 6371.0088 km
structural_ladder.threshold_candidates: all distinct positive pairwise distances within context
structural_ladder.coverage_definition: sum over contexts of each context largest-connected-component node count divided by total deployment nodes participating in contexts with at least one node
structural_ladder.threshold_for_target: smallest positive candidate threshold whose pooled within-context LCC coverage reaches target
structural_ladder.zero_distance_pairs: connected at every positive threshold but never used as threshold candidates
